clue.text: First signs of someone using dependable soap

clue.text: Complication that's no good in account

clue.text: Deadly, just like us

clue.text: One's milieu for a time, following custom

clue.text: Beat chief manager of society's premises

a master is a chief or head

clue.text: In Carousel, one lyric that's unaccompanied

clue.text: Reverses train and makes off

clue.text: Costs hit organisation belonging to my country

clue.text: Remove shirt, like some circus performers

clue.text: Monkey puts sailor in favour

clue.text: No part-exchange for this customer

clue.text: Stunt-girl, say, a spiteful girl hiding loot
